name: Slanted Wall · Fire
primary: A 5-wide wall at 45°: its base stands at the aim point and it rises toward you like an awning, covering you from the front and from the sky; it turns to any angle and the slope is solid with no gaps. Material: magic earth, permanent.
self_description:
A 5-wide wall at 45°: its base stands at the aim point and it rises toward you like an awning, covering you from the front and from the sky; it turns to any angle and the slope is solid with no gaps. Material: magic earth, permanent. On you:
• Heat: sets on fire for 4.5 s (wet targets just dry off), thaws; melts ice and burns roots
